scope: Workspace source and cmap audit plus read-only on-disk package evidence; no Unreal session, AssetRegistry query, Cook, packaging, or executable launch performed by this audit.
corpus_method: Read all top-level Gameplay cpp/h/inl. Explicit DWText pairs and catalog sides retain language labels; remaining Chinese TEXT literals and possible display TEXT literals are conservatively included, including editor previews and diagnostic text. Also audit every TEXT literal as a broader superset. This is not arbitrary future user content coverage.

cook_static_review.assessment: Saved hard-reference design and embedded font payloads make dependencies cook-reachable when the default gameplay map/GameMode and referenced resource Blueprints are cooked. This is conditional static evidence, not a successful Cook result.
reference_design_evidence: DWGameplayHUD.h: GameUIFont and WidgetClass are serialized UPROPERTY fields.
DWInteractionPromptComponent.h: Style is a serialized TObjectPtr UPROPERTY; WidgetClass is inherited from UWidgetComponent.
DWInteractionPromptStyle.h: TitleFont, KeyFont and AppearSound are serialized TObjectPtr UPROPERTY fields.
setup_interaction.py saves HUD font, resource CDO Style and WidgetClass, and shared style asset. Current InteractionSetup.json reports completion without errors.
CreateHandDrawnCompositeFont stores FFontData(UFontFace*) in Default, Regular and Bold entries; font objects are package assets, not temporary FCoreStyle composites.

caveats: Runtime LoadObject/TryLoad string paths alone do not guarantee inclusion. Saved Blueprint/style/widget references are the cook-reachability basis.
The binary name check does not distinguish hard from soft imports or replace a parsed asset dependency/cook audit.
No arbitrary user save names or future translations are guaranteed by this fixed corpus.
Loose OFL/FONTLOG text files need deliberate packaging/staging; placing them under Content does not itself prove they appear in a packaged game.
